name: How can I choose between repairing my existing fence or installing a new one?
description: Consider a new fence if over 25-30% is severely damaged. We assess and help you weigh repair versus replacement costs and benefits.

mainEntity.name: How can I choose between repairing my existing fence or installing a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between repair and new installation depends on the fence's overall condition, age, and the extent of damage. If more than 25-30% of your fence is severely damaged or showing widespread signs of rot and instability, a full replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. We provide a comprehensive assessment to help you weigh the costs and benefits, ensuring you make an informed decision for your property in the East Bay.
